meta.region: Middle East — transitioning to Global from Issue 002

global_thesis: Iran's IRGC has captured the state following Khamenei's assassination. Mojtaba Khamenei is a figurehead installed under IRGC pressure who has not appeared publicly since his 9 March appointment. The constitutional mechanism requiring Supreme Leader confirmation of SNSC decisions is structurally inoperative. The United States is conducting blockade operations and peace negotiations simultaneously against an entity that cannot constitutionally authorize a deal and has every military incentive not to. The ceasefire is a reorganization interval, not a peace-building interval. At the global level, the Iran war has created a bandwidth constraint on US strategic attention that Russia and China are actively exploiting — Russia through energy windfall funding of the Ukraine campaign, China through assertive moves in the South China Sea timed to coincide with maximum US distraction.
global_thesis_timeframe: The IRGC-capture dynamic is expected to persist for 4 to 8 weeks minimum. The ceasefire expires April 21. Whether it extends or collapses determines the immediate trajectory. The US bandwidth constraint thesis operates on a 90-day horizon tied to the Iran war duration.
thesis_continuity: PIVOT — as of April 18. The IRGC-capture thesis holds structurally. The expression pivoted from intransigence to tactical de-escalation, with Iran opening Hormuz on Friday April 18 and the IRGC closing it again within 24 hours. The civilian-military split in Iranian decision-making is now visible and confirmed.

cross_regional_interactions.description: Russia's energy windfall from Hormuz disruption is directly funding the Ukraine campaign. Every week the Iran war continues is a week of additional Russian fiscal relief. Russia has structural incentive to see the conflict extend.

China deployed floating barrier to Scarborough Shoal April 10-11 while US attention was maximally focused on Hormuz. Multi-theater assertiveness timed to US distraction. Pattern to watch going forward.

India summoned Iranian ambassador after two Indian-flagged vessels attacked in strait April 18. India's studied neutrality is under pressure. New Delhi cannot maintain non-alignment if Iranian forces are attacking Indian ships.

Houthi activation contingent on Iran war escalation. If ceasefire collapses, dual-chokepoint scenario becomes live — Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb simultaneously. Most severe global supply disruption outcome.

persian_axis.structural_situation: IRGC-captured state. Mojtaba figurehead unseen since 9 March. Three IRGC veterans hold operational power. Constitutional command structure inoperative.
persian_axis.tactical_vs_structural: IRGC reconstituting missile capability during ceasefire window — structural. Araghchi diplomatic gestures — tactical, overridden by IRGC within hours.
persian_axis.key_watch: Mojtaba public appearance; IRGC internal factional signals; missile base clearance pace

hormuz.structural_situation: Functionally closed. 230 loaded tankers waiting. US naval blockade active since April 13. Iran declared open April 18, IRGC closed again within 24 hours. Mine problem unresolved.
hormuz.tactical_vs_structural: Open-close cycling is tactical leverage management. Mine problem may be structural constraint — Iran may genuinely lack full reopening capability.
hormuz.key_watch: Ceasefire expiry April 21; any tanker transiting under US escort; IRGC tanker attacks

levant.structural_situation: Israel conducting active ground invasion of Lebanon (5 divisions). 10-day ceasefire announced April 17. Hezbollah rejected it. French UNIFIL soldier killed April 18, likely Hezbollah. West Bank systematic consolidation accelerating under cover of larger war.
levant.tactical_vs_structural: Lebanon ceasefire tactical and fragile. West Bank consolidation structural — physical facts being created.
levant.key_watch: Lebanon ceasefire durability; West Bank annexation legislative moves; IDF post-war planning

gulf.structural_situation: GCC hardening from passive to active concession demands. Saudi-UAE divergence beneath unified surface. Qatar seeking reparations.
gulf.key_watch: Any GCC bilateral back-channel with Tehran; Saudi-UAE Yemen competition resurfacing

red_sea_yemen.structural_situation: Houthis not resumed commercial shipping attacks but warned Bab el-Mandeb activation contingent on escalation resumption. Yemen structurally fractured — Houthi north, Saudi-UAE competition in south.
red_sea_yemen.key_watch: Houthi activation signal from Tehran; Pakistan Yemen mediation progress
